title: Revision and snapshots
summary: Explicit refresh updates eligible admitted cases and their existing owner snapshot atomically, preserving targets, provenance, passed acceptance and capture history. Successful captures awaiting review can continue an inherited machine chain; independent judgment still follows complete capture. Item refresh skips shared copies on runs the item has left, preserving remaining members and their live walks. The plan filter belongs only to deployment refresh; item refresh refuses it with recovery. Removed-member stale rows offer no unreachable refresh recipe.
